description: This file contains utility functions for handling JSON files, path normalization, running Vitest test reports, and collecting test durations, primarily used in testing and reporting workflows.

methods.name: normalizeRepoPath
methods.description: Converts file path to a normalized slash-separated format.

methods.name: normalizeTrackedRepoPath
methods.description: Converts a given path to a path relative to the repository root, normalized to slash format.

methods.name: readJsonFile
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file from the specified path.

methods.name: tryReadJsonFile
methods.description: Attempts to read and parse a JSON file; returns fallback on failure.

methods.name: writeJsonFile
methods.description: Serializes a value as JSON and writes it to the specified file.

methods.name: runVitestJsonReport
methods.description: Runs a Vitest test suite with JSON reporting and returns the report file path.

methods.name: collectVitestFileDurations
methods.description: Processes Vitest report data to extract file durations and test counts.
